canDo: Can catch the situation, the main changes, numbers and required actions, and pick out key information in verbes + à/de and in reported speech.
review: Review y/en; organise verbes + à/de systematically, and restate what you hear in reported speech.
output: Write keyword notes; restate them aloud in 30 seconds.
checkpoint: Tell apart two kinds of error — “didn’t hear it” and “didn’t parse the structure”; restate at least 4 key pieces of information.
challenge: Today’s challenge: on RFI’s Journal en français facile, listen twice to a news item of about 1 minute: the first time write only the main idea, the second time note numbers, places and requests; then write 3 sentences in reported speech (On annonce que… / On demande aux gens de…), watching how you use à / de.

questions.why: On the first listening, listen for “who to whom, where, why”; connectors are for the second.
Victor-Hugo is the stop where you change to the tram.
« les deux jardins abandonnés avaient les meilleurs terrains » — what was missing was someone responsible for the plot.
